quality_definition.definition: All required checks must be explicitly true. A false check gives fail; otherwise a missing check gives unavailable. No reference identity, RMSD, QED, strain-delta threshold or docking score is a required check.

training_reference.scope: Actual 17420-member PDBBind-stage training set of the legacy checkpoint; GEOM pretraining, connection-head and official SigmaDock training are not included.

diversity.standardization: RDKit Cleanup + canonical SMILES, atom maps removed, retain components/charge/stereo; no tautomer collapse or neutralization. Morgan radius=2/2048 bits, chirality off for structural similarity.
